site.subtitle: Handloom bedsheets, lived-in comfort, and decor with a pulse.

designs.title: Moonloom Stripe
designs.summary: Cloud-soft cotton with graphite stripes that catch morning light.
designs.detail: Woven on a 120-year-old pit loom in Karur. Washed six times for that lived-in drape Gen-Z bedrooms actually want.

designs.title: Saffron Mist
designs.summary: Warm saffron warp meets mist-grey weft — sunshine, softened.
designs.detail: A limited handloom run with floating selvedge and tonal embroidery along the cuff.

designs.title: Ink Garden
designs.summary: Botanical block prints on charcoal linen — gallery walls, but softer.
designs.detail: Natural dyes, hand-blocked motifs, and a slightly irregular weave that photographs like art.

designs.title: River Check
designs.summary: Oversized checks in river blue and foam — throw it, layer it, live in it.
designs.detail: Lightweight khadi with a brushed face. Designed to look intentional on a messy bed.

designs.title: Petal Grid
designs.summary: A micro-grid of blush petals on bone cotton — romantic, never fussy.
designs.detail: Percale handfeel with a matte finish. Pair with bare walls and one loud playlist.

designs.title: Loom Noir
designs.summary: Near-black handloom with a satin-sheen stripe that only shows when you move.
designs.detail: For the moody bedroom. Dense weave, cool touch, maximal drama with zero clutter.

updates.title: Studio notes: why we wash six times
updates.body: New handloom arrivals feel stiff. Ours don’t. Every KAIRA sheet is washed, dried, and pressed in a slow cycle before it ever hits a shoot — so the first night already feels like night forty.

updates.title: Dropping Night Ritual — a quieter palette
updates.body: Graphite, fog, and one sharp matcha stitch. Night Ritual is for rooms that glow after midnight and still look editorial at noon.

updates.title: Decor edit: cushions that act like sculpture
updates.body: We’re expanding beyond beds. Ink Garden cushions are block-printed in small batches — each motif lands slightly differently. That’s the point.

storyBeats.label: The feel
storyBeats.title: Soft that still has structure.
storyBeats.copy: KAIRA cotton holds shape on the bed and melts when you lie down — the sweet spot between crisp hotel and cloud hoodie.

storyBeats.label: The weave
storyBeats.title: Handloom, not handmade excuses.
storyBeats.copy: Every metre is woven by craftspeople who treat rhythm like music. Irregularities aren’t flaws — they’re proof of touch.

storyBeats.label: The palette
storyBeats.title: Colors that photograph like a moodboard.
storyBeats.copy: Muted matcha, ink, saffron mist, river check. Designed for rooms that live on camera and in real life.

storyBeats.label: The ritual
storyBeats.title: Make the bed feel like a product launch.
storyBeats.copy: Layer, fold, mess it up. Our sets are built for the five-second reel and the eight-hour sleep.
